description: This file defines the SubpanelMerge class, which extends ListViewMerge to handle the merging of subpanel metadata in SuiteCRM modules. It includes methods for loading, transforming, and saving merged subpanel configuration data.

classes.name: SubpanelMerge
classes.description: A class for merging subpanel metadata within SuiteCRM, handling data loading, transformation, and saving.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom metadata files, transforming them into a structure suitable for merging.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Sets the list_fields in mergeData to the merged panel data built from various sources.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the merged subpanel data to a specified file.
